state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. Every `Core\Ldap\Connection` member owes nothing, perf included, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Ldap\Connection'` reports nothing owed.

**Five `Core\Ldap` features still owe proofs.** `bun nv proofs --owed --limit 1000 | grep -i ldap` lists them: `LdapError` (about, examples, hostile, tests), and the enums `ErrorKind`, `Tls`, `Scope` and `Ad\AccountType` (about, examples, tests). An enum is not attacked and not benchmarked.

**The whole-roster check also counts features outside this goal.** Most of what `bun nv proofs --gate` names is `Core\Str` stale perf, `lang` and `Core\Db`. The check `dossier-the-whole-roster-owes-nothing-with-core-ldap` in `data/goals/ldap.json` cannot pass from `Core\Ldap` work alone.

**Two blocks reach `samba-ad`.** `[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `Reader` and is granted to every `Ldap-*` tree; `[ldap.corp-accounts]` binds as `Administrator` and is granted only to the write proofs' directories. `Reader` can run DirSync, but a DirSync entry carries no `cn` for it, so a `changes` example prints the DN. Check a draft with `bun nv proofs --run --id '<feature>' --show`.

**Samba is slow and drops connections.** One `authenticate` takes about 2.3 s, and one `changes` call about 25 ms alone and far more beside the write attacks. A 20000-part filter, a 1 MB cookie or a 10000-name `select` makes Samba close the connection, and every later call on it throws `Unavailable`, so an attack puts such a step last and catches every call. The examples filter on `department` `Sales` (Anna Berg, Carla Diaz) because write proofs add users at the same time.
